fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM187,760. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0057135/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass STPM/Matriculation/A-Level/Pre-U with at least 2.50 CGPA in Biology/Physics and Chemistry AND pass SPM with five (5) credits including three (3) from Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology; OR Diploma (MQF Level 4) in a related field with at least 2.75 CGPA from a recognized institution. CGPAs below 2.75 must be accompanied by at least 3 years (36 months) of working experience in the same field. International students: IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 550 or equivalent
